method: Every check below was made by opening the cited official URL in this session on 2026-10-23 and searching the returned text for the exact stored value. A value that was not found was not assumed: it was either corrected from the page or explicitly recorded as not re-read. Nothing was carried over from another session's notes.
no_hallucination_rule: No number, quote or policy term in this file is inferred. Where the fetch did not reach the part of the page that holds a value (P4-04's weight line), the check says so and the value stays as captured on its original date.
